pages.text: $(italic)A celestial being cast from grace. Frail but devastatingly lethal.$()$(br2)$(bold)Wrath$(): $(item)+15% damage from all sources$(), the highest racial damage bonus.$(br2)$(bold)Tattered Wings$(): slow fall, though not true flight.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Fragile$(): $(warn)-20% max HP$() (4 fewer hearts).$(br2)$(bold)Meat Preference$(): you crave meat to fuel your war.$(br2)$(bold)Fire Vulnerability$(): $(warn)fire sears you deeper than most.$()$(br2)$(bold)Next: eat widely anyway. Spice of Life max-HP bonuses claw back your missing hearts.$()
